title: Why Are Birthrates Plummeting Worldwide?
summary: Patrick Boyle examines why birth rates are falling in nearly every country and argues the standard explanations do not hold up. He presents data suggesting fewer couples forming is a major driver.
why: HN users cite it as a data-rich look at falling fertility that points to declining coupling rather than people choosing fewer kids.

quote.text: He makes the argument that declining birthrates are due more to a fall in coupling than a fall in people in relationships choosing to have kids.
